title: TimeLabels
description: Short, deterministic date/time labels for Swift UIs — 'In 2h', '5mins ago', '3:30 PM', 'Tomorrow'.
why: Turn raw Dates into the short strings a UI needs without duplicating DateFormatter setup across screens. Covers time until/since, durations, clock times and ranges, and contextual dates. Thread-safe, deterministic output with a testable now: parameter, plus Date extensions and a self-updating SwiftUI TimeLabelText. MIT licensed.
stack: Swift 6.0+, SwiftUI, Swift Package Manager — iOS 16+, macOS 13+, watchOS 9+, tvOS 16+, visionOS 1+
